entries.land_location_as_stated: 25 miles NE of Palm Springs; in a rural desert area
entries.description: A lesbian-feminist couple living on their 5-acre farm in a rural desert area northeast of Palm Springs, California, raising vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees and fruit trees. They live simply and like sharing skills with lesbians interested in rural life. Housing and plumbing/electricity; welcomes girl children.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Listing headed by the two women's names, so contact_name filled. PO box is not the land; land_state CA from '25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area'. Type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule: 'We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'; no recruiting of residents. num_residents 2: they live on 'our farm'. Lesbian women as residents; Girl children from 'We welcome: girl children'. Farming/self-sufficiency from 'We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees'. 'enjoy sharing our skills' read as informal hospitality rather than a workshop program, so Workshops/education not coded. Statement of being 'non-racist, non-classist' noted, not coded.

entries.description: A woman-owned commercial dairy and cheese plant in Cool, California, with truck gardening, homestead animals and horses, six dwellings, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns and pasture. The owner invites lesbians with country and animal experience to lease part of the commercial operations or buy shares; ecologically run farming, no drugs.
entries.raw_text: KIDS-LL-EAT IVY FARM 1220 Georgetown Rd, Cool, CA 95614 (916)823-3009. A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture. I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.
entries.notes: Street address taken as the land location. Type Private/Individual Land: written in the first person by one owner ('I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property', 'woman owned commercial farming'). Number of residents not stated. Lesbian women from 'I welcome lesbians'. Farming/self-sufficiency from 'commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals'. Recovery/substance-free from 'NO DRUGS.' Environmentalism/eco-friendly from the requirement to 'believe in, ecologically run ... farming'.

entries.description: A mixed-gender pacifist, vegetarian community on 120 acres in Grand Ronde, Oregon, practicing organic agriculture, permaculture and communal child raising. One lesbian and five others (women and men) live and work on the land, which has housing, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods and farm land. Welcomes new members, children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: FOLLY FARM 9380 Hebo Rd, Grand Ronde, OR 97347 (503)879-5649. We are pacifists, vegetarians, and we practice organic agriculture, permaculture, and communal child raising. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians, 120 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women and men living and working on the land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND: printed under the editor's note 'NOTE: The following is not a women's land group, but it does welcome lesbians as visitors or members.' Street address taken as the land. Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: a group living on the land with 'communal child raising' and welcoming 'new members/residents'. num_residents 6 from '1 lesbian, 5 nonlesbians' with 'women and men living and working on the land'. Lesbian women as a resident; Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children from the welcome list. Gay men and Non-gay men coded because men are members living on the land ('women and men living and working on the land'), orientation not stated. Farming/self-sufficiency from 'we practice organic agriculture'; Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'permaculture' and organic agriculture presented as a practice of the place.

entries.land_location_as_stated: 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage
entries.description: A lesbian-owned campground and housekeeping-cabin resort in Wisconsin on 10 wooded acres with lake frontage: three two-bedroom units, campground with electric hook-ups, showers and camper lounge, and outdoor recreation. Owned by one lesbian with other lesbians helping plan events and manage. Welcomes non-lesbian women, children, cats and dogs.
entries.raw_text: WILDERNESS WAY Box 176, Wascott, WI 54890 (715)466-2635. Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing. Owned by 1 lesbian. Other lesbians active in planning special events and sharing management tasks. We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children, cats and dogs.
entries.notes: Printed under the editor's note 'NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups, but we included them for your information.' Included as a row because it is a campground on its own 10 acres. 'Box 176' with no road treated as a PO box, so land street and zip blank; land_state WI from the mailing address, land city not named. Type Retreat/Gathering Space: a campground and housekeeping units defined by what it offers visitors, although 'Owned by 1 lesbian'. Residents not stated. Lesbian women from owner and lesbians active in management; Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children from 'We welcome: nonlesbian women, girl and boy children'. Cats and dogs also welcomed.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino
entries.description: A private rental cabin with shared bathroom facilities on 2 wooded acres in the redwoods on the Mendocino Coast, California, at $20 per night for up to 3 people. Welcomes non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: PEPPERLAND PO Box 464, Albion, CA 95410 (707)937-0020. We have a quiet, private cabin with detached, shared, bathroom facilities, $20 per night (up to 3 people). We are in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino. We welcome: nonlesbian women. We have: 2 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods.
entries.notes: Printed under the same editor's note ('These groups don't have land, per se, or they aren't exactly land groups'). Included as a row because it describes its own 2 acres. PO box is not the land; land_state CA from 'in the Redwoods on the Mendocino Coast just 9 miles south of Mendocino'. Type Retreat/Gathering Space: defined by a guest cabin rented 'per night'.
